In this question, a statement which is to be taken as true is given and it is followed by two
assumptions numbered I & II. Decide which of the assumption (s) is (are) implicit of the
statement.
Statement: Thenational education policy brings major changes in the education system.
Assumptions: I. Present education system is not supporting the needs of the nation.
II. Present education system is teacher centric.
